`original-columns.html` retains the parallel-column region of Korean Wikisource's

from the 2026-10-22 snapshot SHA-256
`702d920e6f37d0bf9d1ce2dca270f5ea8bfd40b3869b9b9ec336aba3e85012d0`.
김소월; Korean Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0 for contributor text.

The fixture verifies original-column selection, old Hangul, and stanza boundaries.
It does not certify collation against a 1925 scan. Modern text remains in the
fixture so accidental fallback or duplicate-column extraction is observable.
